newsitem.title: CANADA: Inmet says Bougrine suspends Tunisia mining.
newsitem.headline: Inmet says Bougrine suspends Tunisia mining.

text.p: Inmet Mining Corp said on Friday that Societe Miniere de Bougrine SA indefinitely suspended mining and milling operations at its zinc/lead mine in Tunisia.
Inmet holds a 48 percent interest in Bougrine.
Inmet said an evaluation of capital needed to lower operating costs was completed and that Bougrine investors determined the required investment was not justifiable in light of current zinc prices.

Inmet made a partial writedown of its investment in Bougrine in June and expected to make payments of about $33 million for loans made by two international development banks to Bougrine that were guaranteed by Inmet.
